OR3 OpenRouter AI Proxy + Background Jobs — Security Audit Pack

Scope: Server OpenRouter stream proxy, background job start/stream/status/abort, in-process job provider, client stream helpers + background trackers, user API key persistence, tool registry used during streams, related docs/tests.

Primary surfaces:
1. server/api/openrouter/stream.post.ts — SSR stream + _background job start (session/workspace gated)
2. server/api/jobs/* — SSE attach, poll status, abort
3. server/utils/background-jobs/* — stream handler, viewers, memory provider, concurrency
4. app/utils/chat/openrouterStream.ts + useAi-internal/* — client routing, availability caches, background trackers
5. app/composables/chat/useAi.ts — eligibility (tools/modality/background flags)
6. app/core/auth/useUserApiKey + openRouterKeyAvailability — client key persistence / server-route fallback rules
7. server/utils/llm/rate-limiter + shared/openrouter — request shaping / SSE parse / deadlines

Excluded: Full chat UI, sync/storage engines, auth can() implementation (separate pack — jobs still call into it), webhooks, themes/plugins.
